# LAD Media

> NYC & NJ's premier crypto and Web3 marketing agency. We help token launches, NFT collections, DeFi protocols, DAOs, and traditional businesses grow through influencer marketing, PR, community building, and paid media.

## What We Do

LAD Media is a full-service digital marketing agency based in New York City and New Jersey, specializing in the Web3 and cryptocurrency space. We serve founders, project teams, and businesses who need measurable growth — not vanity metrics.

### Core Services

- **Crypto & Web3 Marketing** — End-to-end campaign management for token launches, NFT drops, DeFi protocols, and DAOs. Includes strategy, execution, and performance reporting.
- **Influencer Marketing** — Access to a vetted network of 500+ crypto and Web3 influencers across YouTube, X (Twitter), TikTok, and Telegram. Performance-tracked campaigns with transparent ROI.
- **Press & PR** — Guaranteed media placements in top-tier outlets including CoinTelegraph, Decrypt, CoinMarketCap, Yahoo Finance, Forbes, Bloomberg, and TechCrunch.
- **Community Building** — Discord and Telegram community growth, moderation, engagement strategies, and ambassador programs.
- **Paid Media & Social Ads** — Targeted advertising on X, Google, Reddit, and crypto-native ad networks. Conversion-focused creative and copy.
- **Website & Brand Development** — High-converting landing pages, full websites, and brand identity for Web3 projects and traditional businesses.

## Our Clients

We have worked with projects and businesses including:
- Crypto and DeFi protocols (token launches, presales)
- NFT collections and marketplaces
- HVAC and home services companies (Polar Point HVAC)

- Sports and media platforms (Sports Beep)
- Legal and professional services (William Croach Law)
- Political and advocacy organizations (State Nationalist Reform)
- AI and EdTech platforms (Maatiai)
- Blockchain infrastructure (Verifed.xyz, Mispar)

- Based in NYC & NJ — available for in-person strategy sessions
- Specialized in crypto/Web3 — we understand tokenomics, community dynamics, and the regulatory landscape
- Results-focused — we track every dollar and every impression
- Fast execution — campaigns go live within days, not months
